distillation.initialization: fresh; no checkpoint, normalizer, or replay state from the 0.12 m experiment
distillation.convergence: validation plateau plus three stable generated-distribution checks
distillation.maximum_epochs: 5000 is a failing runaway guard only

evaluator.scope: the same frozen R04 library is used for q0 audit, screening, Adam20 gradient endpoints, formal centers, and replay scores

online_round.valid_rollout: store all 21 formal centers from Adam step 0 through step 20
online_round.invalid_rollout: store the represented step-0 start and skip Adam
online_round.trajectory_batch: base batch times ceil(mean(points per replay rollout)), at most 21x; microbatch 256; one optimizer step after full accumulation

resources.teacher_generation: one P107 two-GPU job uses 8 CPU workers
resources.distillation_and_online: two P107 RTX5090 GPUs and 8 CPU cores
resources.stop: one-hour wall reserve or STOP_AFTER_ROUND sentinel
